uri-alias-mapping.title: URI Aliases
uri-alias-mapping.description:
OntoPuS will redirect incoming requests according to the aliases specified below.  
`Resource -> Alias`  
The resource must not match any identifier which exists in a published ontology.

configuredAliases.title: Application-configured aliases
configuredAliases.description: These aliases are configured in the application configuration and cannot be changed through the UI.
configuredAliases.items.title: Configured alias

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: The requested address that should be redirected to the Destination.

alias.title: Destination
alias.description: The destination to which the Resource should be redirected.
